::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Novr 30th [1886?]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Special Collections, The Shakespeare Centre, Stratford-upon-Avon.
:::

My dear [Mrs Barrett Lennard](people/person_121.qmd)

I am afraid I do not know any one at Cambridge well enough to write about one whom I do not personally know.  I do not think second hand recommendations have much effect  people have so many first hand.  In fact I only slightly know two people there.  I was there some twelve or fourteen years ago and like you, was edified by the admiration of ‘Our Backs’-  I never could care for Cambridge as for Oxford.

I am sure I sent you our [Magazine](organizations/other_85.qmd) for November.[^1] There was an account of the Colonial Exhibition in it, written by [Miss Finlaison](people/person_512.qmd)  I hope it did not fail of coming.  

yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Perhaps the *Otterbourne Parish Magazine*.  The India and Colonial Exhibition took place in South Kensington in 1886.
